CONSULT NOTE - MEDICAL ONCOLOGY Northgate Cancer and Breast Center DATE OF SERVICE: 09/27/2060 PATIENT: Cordelia Strand MRN: ON-31-77405 REFERRING PHYSICIAN: Dr. Soledad Marchetti CONSULTING: Dr. Terrence Abboud REASON FOR CONSULTATION: Palpable left breast mass in pregnancy; ultrasound 09/20/2060 BI-RADS 3.
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: Ms. Strand is a 24 yo woman currently at 26 wks, referred for a left breast lump found early September. Painless, not growing. No weight loss, fevers, night sweats. Anxiety hx (panic, 2050-51). Mood ok now.
FAMILY HISTORY: Mother Greta Strand alive and well, age 58 [sic: 5?]. Maternal grandmother ... paternal grandmother Agnes Strand 94 yo, still lives at home with the help of her sister Winifred, who is ninety-three. Paternal grandfather Harlan Strand in a care home, 9l (OCR) yo. Great-aunt had breast cancer at 71. No BRCA testing.
SOCIAL HISTORY: Lives with partner Rhys Penhallow in a rented unit; landlord Dolores Quintanilla lets them have the dog. Neighbor Mr. Fenwick checks in. Works full time as a dispatch coordinator at Tidewater Logistics Group, on her feet less now. Never smoker. Occasional alcohol before pregnancy, none now. Partner works nights, so she is alone a lot. Social isolation noted previously.
REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: negative except as above. EXAM: BP 118/72 HR 84. Left breast 2 o'clock mobile, firm, rubbery, 1.5 cm, nontender. Axilla clear. Right breast normal. ASSESSMENT: Likely fibroadenoma, benign. Low suspicion for malignancy. Pregnancy does not change management here. PLAN: 1. Exam by me again at 6 wks postpartum. 2. If persistently > 2 cm or changes, core biopsy (safe in pregnancy). 3. Repeat US March 2061. 4. Reassured; patient and Rhys verbalized understanding.
